function.name: read_artifact_logs
function.description:
Read the debug log of an HTML artifact app, newest first: what its pages reported while people used them. A page that loads /api/v1/client.js reports uncaught errors, unhandled promise rejections, console.error and console.warn, the SDK's own sync trouble (reconnects, conflicts, rejected writes, resets, going unavailable), and whatever the page passes to happy.debug.log.

Each entry shows its level, source, message, data, who was using the page, when it arrived, and the artifact's newest version then. Filter by level, user, and time; 50 entries per page by default. The log keeps the newest 1000 entries of the last 7 days. Use it after someone reports a problem with an app, or after publishing a new version, to see what broke.

level.description: The least severe level shown: "error" shows errors only, "warn" warnings and errors, "info" everything (default)

userId.description: Only entries this user's pages reported

since.description: Only entries received at or after this time, ISO 8601

until.description: Only entries received at or before this time, ISO 8601

pageCursor.description: The nextPageCursor of the previous page, for older entries
